chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from some of his companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"It is to be buried and not sold."
Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan said: And it is by this report that we act, to the exclusion of the first one.

key_terms.الْخَبَرِ: the report or hadith being relied upon

ai.seo_question: When a substance is ruled unusable, should it be buried rather than sold according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the item in question is to be buried rather than sold. The compiler, Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, explicitly states that this report is the one relied upon over an earlier report, indicating its juridical preference in deriving the ruling.
